description: hello everyone I'm junior data analyst passionate about uncovering insight using sql, excel and visualization tools such as power bi this is my first hackathon and I'm excited to take this opportunity and challenge myself by analyzing real-world NASA observation datasets to detect systems trends
summary:
For the NASA Space Apps Challenge, I developed a comprehensive regional climate and precipitation analysis for Morocco from 2000 to 2025. Using NASA MERRA-2 meteorological data, I evaluated long-term precipitation trends, water availability, and regional climate shifts.
To solve this challenge, I built an end-to-end analytical solution entirely by myself, featuring an interactive Power BI dashboard for dynamic data visualization, structured Excel datasets, and a professional 7-slide PDF presentation summarizing all key metrics. This project delivers practical, data-driven insights to support water resource management and agricultural planning in Morocco.
